The ledger API claims describe only write, read, and history operations — `Ledger::append_object`, `Ledger::get_object`, `Ledger::object_at`, `Ledger::object_history`, and `Ledger::all_objects` — and none of them mention deleting or tombstoning an object already written to the ledger. The only tombstone reference, `VectorIndex::tombstoned` (ekos/crates/ledger/src/vector.rs:186), is in the vector index, not a ledger-object delete or tombstone operation. Delete methods do exist on storage backends (`ObjectStoreBackend::delete`, `LocalFsBackend::delete`, `MemBackend::delete`) and elsewhere (branch.rs, mcp.rs, web models), but no claim states that any of these delete or tombstone an object already written to the ledger. So the evidence does not show that EKOS supports deleting or tombstoning a written ledger object.
